title: ARC published plan snapshot
description: Immutable machine projection of an owner-approved execution plan. Written ONLY by /arc-publish-plan. Read-only for every worker.

planId.description: Immutable snapshot identifier. Doubles as the directory name under plans/. "arcs" is reserved for the plans/arcs/ per-ARC pointer container (P-V11, B4).

source.description: Repo-relative path of the source artifact. Validated against traversal at publish time (P-V12).

sourceHash.description: SHA-256 of source.md as captured in this snapshot.

repoRef.description: Full 40-character commit SHA the plan was authored against (P-V10).

mutexRegistry.description: Closed registry. A task may not reference a class absent from this list (P-V5).

safeParallelSets.description: Declared concurrency sets. Checked for mutex intersection at publish time (P-V9).

executionProfiles.description: OPTIONAL (V1.2 P-A). Publisher-owned embedded snapshot field: the execution profiles resolved from the committed library (references/execution-profiles/) and embedded, hash-pinned, at publish time. Written ONLY by P-B resolution - never authored in a source. Absent in every legacy snapshot; its absence never invalidates a plan.

arcId.description: OPTIONAL (B4, P-E0). Declared by the publisher for an ARC-scoped snapshot; absent in every legacy snapshot. Must equal manifest.json.arcId and plans/arcs/<ARC-ID>/current.json.arcId (three-way equality, K9).

taskId.description: Uppercase, filesystem-safe, must start and end alphanumeric. The leading-alphanumeric rule alone excludes the reserved __PUBLISH__ and __OWNER__ holder ids; the trailing rule excludes NTFS-hostile trailing dots and hyphens.

arcId.description: OPTIONAL (B4, P-E0). ARC identity. Absent in every legacy record; present in every ARC-scoped record and equal to the ARC it belongs to - the publisher's ARC literal for a snapshot, its manifest and plans/arcs/<ARC-ID>/current.json (three-way equality), the arc-claims/<ARC-ID>/ directory for claims, tokens and the holders taken for that ARC. Never inferred from a task-id prefix, a filename or a slug. The reserved Windows device-name guard applies uniformly (N-3). The schema validates shape only; namespace rules live in scripts/lib/runtime-identity.js.

lane.description: HERDR is deliberately absent. Herdr is a host/orchestrator, never an execution lane (contract principle 4, V-3).

mutexClass.description: Canonical form retains the colon. Only the on-disk directory name substitutes __ for it, because : is illegal in an NTFS filename.

entryMode.description: Routing is read from the snapshot only. A worker may never upgrade or downgrade this value.

requiresOwnerGo.description: true means the worker claims into WAITING_OWNER_GO and stops without executing.

priority.description: Lower runs first. The worker selects the lowest-priority-number eligible task.

stopCondition.description: Structurally non-empty when present. Literalness is enforced by P-V15, not by a length threshold: the ratified corpus shows legitimate conditions (9-375 chars) overlapping pointer-shaped values (8-18 chars), so no minLength separates them.

mustNotParallelWith.description: Must be symmetric (P-V8). Mutex classes are symmetric by construction and are the preferred expression.

executionProfile.description: OPTIONAL (V1.2 P-A). Library reference id - the ONLY authoring surface for execution profiles. Resolved against references/execution-profiles/<id>.json and embedded into executionProfiles by the publisher (P-B, not yet active).
